name: Happy Glamper
signature: Mobile bell-tent glamping service that pitches styled tents at nominated Peninsula foreshore campsites — children welcome, setup handled for you
editorNote:
Happy Glamper is a mobile bell-tent service rather than a fixed site: they pitch styled tents at nominated Peninsula foreshore campsites, handle setup and styling, and pack down after your stay. Multiple tent sizes; children welcome; some configurations sleep up to eight guests.

Balnarring Deluxe is the most documented fixed-location product, with campsite fees included. The Spa Dreaming Centre add-on at Peninsula Hot Springs is available as an optional extra — if you are pairing glamping with a thermal day, this is the configuration to ask about.

Rates from approximately $200–$230 per night, but these were last confirmed in 2023. Get a current quote directly before committing.
whyWeGo: Mobile glamping pitched at your chosen Peninsula foreshore site — the most flexible glamping format on the Peninsula for families and groups.
ifOnlyOneThing: Ask for the Balnarring Deluxe configuration — site fee included and the most consistent setup.
